steps.title: Translations panel
steps.content: This panel shows the current verse in all the translations you have selected. Click the Translations tab to open the panel.

steps.title: Your selected translations
steps.content: Cards at the top show each selected translation and its text for this verse.

steps.title: More Translations
steps.content: Use this list to add more translations. Try it! Click a translation and it will appear as a new card above.

steps.title: Filter the list
steps.content: Type part of a translation name or even its abbreviation (like KJV) to search More Translations.

steps.title: Star for parallel reading
steps.content: Star a translation and it will be added to the parallel Bible columns. Unstarred ones stay here for a deeper dive into a verse. You can't unstar your last translation.

steps.title: Drag to rearrange
steps.content: Drag the ⋮ handle to reorder selected translations. Your starred translations will appear in the parallel Bible in that same order.
